chunks: And the Imam (peace be upon him) said:

Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'So those [angels] who divide the matter,' he said: 'The angels distribute the provisions of the children of Adam between the rising of the dawn and the rising of the sun; so whoever sleeps in between, he misses his provision.'

key_terms.فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْراً: Those who divide the matter (Quranic phrase referring to angels distributing sustenance)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of sleeping between dawn and sunrise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the 'dividers' in Surah An-Nazlat as angels distributing sustenance between dawn and sunrise, linking this celestial activity to the spiritual and physical state of the believer. This hadith underscores the significance of the Fajr prayer and waking for Tahajjud, as sleeping through this window is believed to result in a missed portion of one's daily rizq, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegetical tradition regarding the interplay between worship and divine decree.
